I was up at all hours, tidying the bakery, experimenting with new recipes, redecorating the whole front counter. My mind was just buzzing with ideas, one after another, so many I couldn't keep track, and I’d jump from one thing to the next, never quite finishing. It wasn't like me; I just couldn't sit still or settle my thoughts. My daughter told me I was talking too fast, but I just felt like I had so much to say.

Then, about two months ago, everything just… stopped. I lost all interest in going to the bakery, barely wanted to talk to anyone. The fatigue is crushing, even after a full night’s sleep – if you can call it that now, because getting out of bed feels impossible. I keep replaying moments in my head, feeling like I’ve ruined everything, that it’s all my fault somehow that things are the way they are, even things that make no sense. It’s hard to focus on anything, even old hobbies. I just feel utterly drained and guilty, all the time.
D008-D001_h001.question_a:
"Doctor, I'm not sure what's going on with me lately. It's like I'm two different people. For the past month, I've had this incredibly high energy, almost like I’m buzzing. My mind was just racing, ideas flying everywhere, so fast I couldn’t keep up. I’d try to focus on one recipe, but then another idea would pop up, and I’d be off to something else in a flash.

But before that, for about two months, it was the complete opposite. I just wanted to be by myself; I couldn't even bring myself to talk to my old friends. I was so exhausted all the time, even after sleeping. And the guilt... it was crushing. I kept thinking my late husband's death was somehow my fault, even though the doctors said it was his heart. It felt incredibly real, like I was truly responsible. All these issues with my focus, the rapid thoughts, and especially not needing sleep, it all really only started when I got this surge of energy a month ago. I’ve always been a pretty level-headed person, so this is very new. It's not something I've dealt with my whole life."
D008-D001_h001.question_b:
